title: Simplex shuffle lattice paths and their partition signs
statement:
Let $a,b\in\mathbf N$ and $n=a+b$. Define $L_{a,b}$ to be the set of coordinatewise monotone maps $w:\{0,\ldots,n\}	o\{0,\ldots,a\}	imes\{0,\ldots,b\}$ such that $w_1(k)+w_2(k)=k$ for every $k$. Thus each step increases exactly one coordinate by one. Let $\mu(w)=\{r<n:w_1(r)<w_1(r+1)\}$ and $
u(w)=\{r<n:w_2(r)<w_2(r+1)\}$ be its horizontal and vertical step positions. Define its integral sign by $\epsilon(w)=(-1)^{\#\{(r,s):0\le r<s<n,\ r\in
u(w),\ s\in\mu(w)\}}\in\mathbf Z$. This is the sign of the permutation listing $\mu(w)$ followed by $
u(w)$, each increasingly. The definition includes $a=0$, $b=0$ and the length-zero path.
